requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall maintain a 7-year immutable audit trail of all transactions for accountability and compliance.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring that users can access essential functionalities even during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Both requirements were aligned to maintain a 7-year audit trail for accountability.
Both requirements were integrated for unified user access control.
Logging delay and error handling requirements were adjusted to accommodate both safety and efficiency.
Processing speed and energy efficiency were optimized to align with both requirements.
Concurrent processing and carbon footprint reduction were balanced to meet both goals.
